name: dsh-rightbar
description: Right bar: vn-harness' own right Sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - the tab strip, the docking panel, the expand control, the tab-type registry (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight), the keyed tab seats and the Start/guide page. Vendored from the shipped @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right bundle so the pack owns the code, with the patch list in scripts/sync-vendored.ps1 applied on top (today: the dock's two-pane cap lifted to the kit's own four); the bundle layer disables the core row. Alpha.
